packet_ingest.unique_value_retained: Explicitly binds the active_turns.effect_id race hypothesis to the stronger call-scoped tool_use_id platform identity and keeps the race as OPEN until runtime ordering is measured.

Confirms that the live normal PreToolUse path uses nonblocking admission bookkeeping while the same hook surface can emit a real deny only for the narrow SEBUKKU branch; normal admission status is therefore not effect enforcement.

new_value_retained: Perception Control mechanically preserves NOT_COMPUTED through COMPUTE_OFF and dependency taint when callers route through evaluate_head.
A historical component receipt reports a real-camera ablation with object.known.cup COMPUTE_OFF -> NOT_COMPUTED while person.presence remained OK; scope remains component-only and was not rerun here.
VoiceSessionCapsule is an ephemeral cross-source projection and needs generation/consistent-read binding before stronger autonomous conditioning.

Realtime response cancellation/barge-in clears pending tool calls before dispatch, supplying a concrete donor pattern for pre-dispatch effect cancellation without solving already-submitted UNKNOWN outcomes.

new_or_strengthened_atoms.claim: Frankenstein-2.0 must bind PreToolUse -> enforcement -> execution -> PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure -> result re-entry to immutable tool_use_id or an equally exact invocation_id. session_id is context only and cannot be the sole mutable effect pointer.
new_or_strengthened_atoms.counterhypothesis: The installed host may serialize relevant calls strongly enough that the donor race is latent rather than observed.
new_or_strengthened_atoms.falsifier: Capture at least two same-session state-changing tool calls and prove exact tool_use_id/effect_id lifecycle ordering. A mismatch confirms the donor race; strict serialization bounds current-host risk but does not justify discarding call identity in 2.0.

new_or_strengthened_atoms.claim: COMPUTE_OFF, OUTPUT_OFF and MEMORY_OFF are useful because they alter computation/egress/persistence rather than merely tagging output. Central dependency resolution can propagate taint and return NOT_COMPUTED/value=None before a prohibited compute_fn runs.
new_or_strengthened_atoms.boundary: System-wide privacy credit is not established until all live sensitive callers are shown to pass through evaluate_head or an equivalent enforced adapter; several detector functions remain simple scaffolds and detector quality is separate from policy-enforcement quality.
new_or_strengthened_atoms.world_substrate_delta: WorldNeed/WorldSlice and GRID cell controls must preserve NOT_COMPUTED through dependency chains. A disabled protected variable cannot be reconstructed by a downstream operator or similarity path.

new_or_strengthened_atoms.claim: VoiceSessionCapsule is correctly shaped as a RAM/session-scoped compiled projection over canonical sources, but it reads several sources without an explicit common generation or transactional snapshot.
new_or_strengthened_atoms.grid10_delta: The Frankenstein-2.0 Voice/GRID context compiler should carry source refs plus a generation/freshness boundary, preserve UNKNOWN/conflict, enforce privacy tiers and emit a conditioning digest/receipt. The capsule must not become a second durable state authority.

new_or_strengthened_atoms.claim: Realtime queues tool calls until response completion and clears pending calls when the response is cancelled/non-completed or barge-in truncates the parent response, preventing an interrupted candidate from executing after its parent thought was invalidated.
new_or_strengthened_atoms.boundary: This only protects pre-dispatch pending calls in the Realtime path. It is not canonical EffectGate authority and cannot convert an already-submitted ambiguous external effect into FAILED or SAFE_TO_RETRY.
new_or_strengthened_atoms.grid10_delta: Introduce a typed candidate/pending-effect lifecycle where cancellation or supersession can invalidate an effect before deterministic EffectGate submission; after submission, transport ambiguity becomes UNKNOWN and cannot be blindly replayed.

contradictions_and_open_boundaries.resolution: Donor stern normal effect admission is nonblocking bookkeeping; 2.0 still requires exact deterministic enforcement at the real effect boundary.

contradictions_and_open_boundaries.claim: stern points to an older host-only wache-koenig blocker, but exact source/config/order/runtime reachability are unavailable in the pinned donor artifact. Repository absence does not prove host absence.

Perception Control enforcement is mechanically strong at the evaluated adapter, but source-wide caller compliance is not yet proven; policy-enforcement credit and detector-quality credit remain separate.

triggerword4_handoff_delta: Require immutable per-invocation effect identity; never use one session-wide mutable current-effect slot as the authority contract.
Keep ADMISSION_DECISION, ENFORCEMENT_DECISION, EXECUTION_RECEIPT, WORLD_EFFECT_VERIFICATION, RESULT_REENTRY and COMPLETION_EVIDENCE distinct and generation/provenance bound.
Port NOT_COMPUTED plus dependency-taint propagation into sparse WorldNeed/WorldSlice and GRID control; prohibited variables cannot be reconstructed downstream.
Treat VoiceSessionCapsule as an ephemeral compiler view with generation/freshness/privacy/provenance binding, not a memory authority.
Generalize Realtime pending-tool cancellation into a pre-dispatch candidate-effect cancellation state; preserve UNKNOWN after possible external submission.
Do not award blocking-effect credit to wache-koenig until exact source/config/order and executable reachability are recovered.
next_exact_gate: Recover or permanently classify the host-only wache-koenig enforcement predecessor; audit every live sensitive perception caller for evaluate_head bypass; then encode tool_use_id-bound effect lifecycle, NOT_COMPUTED taint propagation, Voice/GRID generation binding and pre-dispatch cancellation as explicit Triggerword-4 acceptance contracts.
